ranked.headline: Reducing patch and annotation demands in histopathology segmentation and tumour analysis

ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers release installable Python, R and Rust tools that package omics preprocessing, visualization and ML inference.

ranked.summary: Chromatin accessibility readouts now span cross-organ atlases, neurodevelopmental lineages, and neurodegenerative disease profiling.

ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications describe omics software and models for variant scoring, expression prediction, clustering, and network analysis.

ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications report faster, lower-memory k-mer, minimizer and language-model tools for microbial and phage genome analysis.

ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one publication report reference-free or alignment-free methods for assembly QC, long-read phasing, and ancestry inference.
